title: Unified Threat Detection and Mitigation Framework (UTDMF): Combating Prompt Injection, Deception, and Bias in Enterprise-Scale Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset and measuring fairness metrics such as demographic parity and equalized odds across simulated enterprise workflows (e.g., discriminatory recommendations in financial chatbots, biased treatment suggestions in healthcare agents, and bias amplification in hiring tools).
Assessing combined and systemic unfairness in model outputs through threat chaining simulations and activation forecasting to predict bias amplification in dynamic, multi-agent enterprise scenarios.
